cases.given: Two available compatible models A and B
cases.when: Change the knowledge model A to B and back through applied configuration
then: Real inference requests target the configured model each time
Public frontend/business interface is unchanged

cases.given: Independent knowledge, writing, agent and moderation bindings
then: Other role bindings remain unchanged
Actual writing requests use the new binding

cases.given: A stream is running on A
then: Existing stream completes or cancels on A
A new request uses B
Each response records its actual model/configuration version

cases.given: An agent binding lacks required tool support
then: Capability error is explicit
No invented tool result is accepted
No unconfigured fallback occurs

cases.given: Local and remote adapters with separate credential references
cases.when: Switch configured provider or an upstream times out
then: Errors and cancellation follow the shared contract
Secrets are absent from client responses/logs
No unconfigured external upload occurs

cases.given: A ready index built using embedding model E1
then: The existing compatible index remains usable

cases.given: An index from E1 and a proposed embedding model/version E2
then: A new compatible index is built and verified before activation
Old and new vectors are never silently mixed
Dimension mismatch is rejected
Rollback is explicit

cases.given: Only public posts/comments/rules are approved for phase one
cases.when: Switch models, invoke tools, or query after content visibility changes
then: Private group/direct-message data is not exposed or trained by default
Removed or restricted content is unavailable through stale index/cache
Retrieved text cannot escalate tool permissions

cases.given: The service reads a valid AI_MODEL_CONFIG_FILE and a request is running on A
cases.when: Publish B at a higher revision, then publish invalid and stale data, then publish A at another higher revision
then: New requests follow A, B, B, A with monotonically increasing accepted revisions
The in-flight request stays on the original A
A configured file with no previously valid revision cannot silently fall back to inline configuration
